(Answering inside the brain-map view: mention the exact repo-relative paths of every relevant file so the map can highlight them.)

Let me read the most relevant curated threads on RG search WU optimization.

Grounded in the curated forum threads under `brain/bubble-forum/`. Here's what experienced builders actually recommend for cutting WU on RG searches — with the corrections the experts posted, since the popular advice has errors.

## Community consensus (with expert corrections)

**1. Never run a search *inside* a RG cell.**
If each cell fires its own `Do a search for…`, WU scales with row count. Calculate the data once (custom state or backend workflow) and have the cell reference that.
`brain/bubble-forum/performance--the-bubble-lag-your-app-was-fast-at-10-users-but-now-at-500--382185.md:11`

**2. Constrain in the search, not with client-side filters — but know which is which.**
The popular "avoid `:filtered`" advice is wrong and two experts (georgecollier, ahmed.elkaffas) corrected it in-thread: `:filtered` runs **server-side**. It's `:filtered` **Advanced** that runs client-side — that's the one that pulls the whole list to the browser and burns WU. Put constraints in the `Do a search for…` itself; use plain `:filtered` freely; avoid the *Advanced* option.
`brain/bubble-forum/performance--the-bubble-lag-your-app-was-fast-at-10-users-but-now-at-500--382185.md:36-51`

**3. Load only when the element is visible + paginate.**
For an SPA (which is exactly your single `App` page pattern), gate each RG's data source on `When ThisElement is visible`, so switching modules doesn't load every table at once. Combine with pagination so you fetch a page of rows, not the whole set.
`brain/bubble-forum/workload-units--optimizing-data-loading-in-a-single-page-application-352720.md:18-24`

**4. `:count` / `:sum` are NOT the expensive villain they're made out to be.**
georgecollier's correction: an aggregate search is *cheaper* in WU than one that returns rows, and only slows down past ~500k rows. Precompute a stored total only if you need to **sort** by it (you can't sort by an aggregate). Don't prematurely denormalize.
`brain/bubble-forum/performance--the-bubble-lag-your-app-was-fast-at-10-users-but-now-at-500--382185.md:28-30`

**5. Loading spinner ≠ WU fix.** The long "Loading Repeating Groups" thread concluded the perceived RG lag is a *rendering/UX* problem, not a data-fetch one — spinner tricks don't cut WU. Fix the search, not the animation.
`brain/bubble-forum/performance--loading-repeating-groups-lets-fix-this-once-and-for-all-85726.md`

## How this maps to CRS

Your `CLAUDE.md` sidebar pattern already says every RG must constrain by `Current User's property`, not just company — that's exactly recommendation #2 (server-side constraint) and keeps result sets small. The `App`-page-SPA design makes #3 (visibility-gated loading) the highest-leverage win: gate each module's RG on `v = <route>` **and** element visibility so switching modules doesn't fan out searches.

## Caveat

All of the above is **community advice, not official docs** — the threads themselves contain disputed claims that got corrected in replies. For the authoritative WU model (what each operation actually costs), the official manual under `brain/bubble/` overrides.
